comment: The shared-factor claim (c6) covers separations 7-9 for all species pairs. Run 013-015 (separation 8, inside the interval) gives mixed-pair coefficients at 0.76-0.84 of the P-0005 table, with the two coefficients of A-B agreeing at 0.76-0.77. This matches the A-A factor at 8 (0.77, run 003). Run 004 (A-A, separation 9) gives factor 0.68 against 0.65 claimed at 9 (4% higher, inside the 0.06 predicted error). Not run against the P-0006 predictor, whose constants do not cover separation 8.
